accepted.sentence: Fresh chunks are often mixed with other fruits to add a tart, juicy contrast to fruit salads.
Small pieces serve as a sweet, tangy topping on some pizzas, especially alongside savory ingredients.
Cooked with spices, the fruit forms a chutney that pairs with curries, grilled meats, or cheese.
Rings are baked beneath soft cake batter, then inverted to create a glazed upside-down dessert.
Its puree can be churned into sorbet, where sugar and freezing turn it into a refreshing dairy-free dessert.
Roasted wedges can accompany pork or poultry as a warm, sweet-tart side dish.
Long leaves supply tough fibers that artisans process into textiles and other woven materials.
Juice and peel left from commercial processing can be converted into feed ingredients for livestock.
